view_frame: The drawing presents a wheel disc in two views. The FRONT view (XZ plane) displays the circular face of the wheel, with X representing the horizontal width and Z representing the vertical height. The RIGHT view (YZ plane) displays the side profile, with Y representing the depth (thickness) and Z representing the vertical height. The wheel is centered at the origin (0,0,0).

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). The profile is defined in the XY plane (rotated to XZ for display) and extruded along the Y-axis from Y=-4 to Y=4. The profile consists of an outer circle (R=60) and an inner circle (R=50) forming the rim, a central hub circle (R=15), and 8 rectangular spokes connecting the hub to the rim.
features.evidence: Front view shows concentric circles and 8 radial spokes. Text annotation specifies 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm; 8 spokes'. Right view confirms uniform thickness.

connections: The 8 spokes connect the central hub to the inner face of the outer rim.
The rim and hub are concentric circles centered at the origin.
edit_rules: Changing 'OD 120 mm' scales the outer rim radius and the length of the spokes.
Changing 'thickness 8 mm' adjusts the extrusion depth along the Y-axis.
Changing 'ASSUMED hub_diameter' adjusts the hub radius and the inner start point of the spokes.
Changing 'ASSUMED rim_width' adjusts the inner radius of the rim and the outer end point of the spokes.
unresolved: Hub diameter is not dimensioned; an assumption of 30 mm is used.
Rim width (radial thickness) is not dimensioned; an assumption of 10 mm is used.
Spoke width is not dimensioned; an assumption of 10 mm is used.
